answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 33560 Country: Pakistan Title: Is it allowed to pray fardh salah with jamah at home with my mother as my only muqtadi and I make her stand behind me not next to me? Question: Is it allowed to pray fardh salah with jamah at home with my mother as my only muqtadi and I make her stand behind me not next to me? Do I get the 27 times reward of jamah by doing so? If I do it continuously without any reason, is it still lawful or does it get makrooh without any plausible reason? Answer ID: 33560 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1277/1277/M=1432) If jama’ah is missed sometimes you can do jama’ah with your mother at your home, but she shall stand behind you. You shall get the reward of jama’ah but not the reward of mosque. It is depriving oneself with the reward by not joining the jama’ah of the mosque without any excuse and making a habit to do jama’ah at home. Males should join the jama’ah of the mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
